QUOTE: ".yaml, .yml, .json | yes | none, by design" and "YAML and JSON: they are in the file set so they can be found by name and named in the miss report. Their keys are never symbols"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says YAML/JSON are registered in the file set (path row) with no definitions/symbols, contrasted with shell/CMake which do carry definitions.
